The final scoped checks passed: precheck (10/10 proofs), proof layout (40 steps, 0 defects), rendering (17 files, 0 errors), focused dependency checks, content policy, coverage, strict proof contracts, dependency levels, and source fetch verification (3/3). The source and scope details are in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-26.notes.md), [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-26.pages.json), and [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-26.proof-contracts.json).

All 15 Step 1 records are **escalated** pending upstream reconciliation: the required rate distortion page and Batch 11 supplier are still draft, with no native acceptance recorded. The run also remains at `1-scaffold` (61/81 covered) with a planner JSON parsing blocker. Aggregate Step 1 checking stops on a duplicate item in another batch; run-wide proof-contract coverage stops on an empty inventory for another page. These blockers and their exact evidence are recorded in the notes. No published content, shared plan, engine state, verdicts, or other pair’s files were edited.
